item: H3 H — Audit: no number enters a doc without (source, date) or an explicit ASSUMED tag
method: Programmatic scan of all 98 repo .md files for number+unit patterns (773 lines), followed by manual review of core investment docs. False positives excluded: methodology-stat percentages (5% significance, 80% power), UI/DPI scaling (100%/150%), table cells that are computed results, dead figures already marked KILLED in-line.

critical_violations.issue: G2 Horizon gate quotes a figure killed by A9 (HORIZON_LADDER_A9.md): no implementation in either repo, unit unstated (per-trade vs per-year differs 365x), gross/net unstated. Still embedded in a live gate definition.
critical_violations.status: KILLED figure presented as live gate basis
critical_violations.fix: Replace with the 96x ratio between 15m and 1D hold, or cite HORIZON_LADDER_A9.md; mark the old figure as DEAD/not evidence.

critical_violations.issue: Section 2a presents these as measured results. H2 audit killed +0.11%/yr as a price-only/raw-close artifact (COMS e8dc5ca total-return check: dividend-adjusted total return is +2.89%/yr). No committed implementation produces either figure. Presented without ASSUMED tag or dead marking.
critical_violations.status: KILLED figure presented as measured result
critical_violations.fix: Remove or clearly mark DEAD/not evidence; replace with total-return figure or remove the value subsection pending a committed implementation.

clean_docs.note: All central-bank rates carry source URLs and fetch dates (RBA 3 Nov 2026, RBNZ 28 Oct 2026, BOJ 30 Oct 2026, SNB since 20 Jun 2025, FRED). Carry figures computed from measured data. Passes H3.

All numbers derived from the stated formula annual cost drag = (365 / holding_days) x round_trip_bps with units explicit throughout (bp per round trip, round trips per year, annual drag %). The +24.21 bp figure is explicitly marked KILLED. Passes H3.

H2 audit table (L67-86) already documents claim status for all model-sourced numbers. The remaining violations above are the in-line body occurrences that lack qualification. JFQA-cited figures at L124-125 (Meursault 2.87%-1.54%; HML +5.20%/yr vs -0.86%/yr) are primary-verified. Passes H3 with the caveat above.

summary: 773 number+unit lines scanned across 98 markdown files. 5 critical violations (killed/dead figures still presented as live evidence, including an internal contradiction in the framework's own closing claim) and 10 moderate violations (policy thresholds, unsourced allocations, unverified model figures without in-line qualification). Two docs pass H3 outright (VERDICT_200.md, HORIZON_LADDER_A9.md). VALUE_VS_PEAD_EVIDENCE.md passes with caveats (H2 audit table exists but body occurrences unqualified). INVESTMENT_DECISION_FRAMEWORK.md and CAPITAL_ALLOCATION.md require fixes.
done_condition: Audit complete: all investment-relevant numbers in core docs classified as cited, assumed, killed-unmarked, or unverified. Artifact written. No numbers were changed — this is an audit, not a correction pass (corrections require coordinated edits across sessions per HORIZON_LADDER_A9.md:110-111).
